desc: The confidence you'll get with the highly versatile Trijicon Tenmile HX by your side. Expect pinpoint precision at long range, all-weather performance you can trust in the middle of nowhere and extremely precise, repeatable adjusters. And the first focal plane MOA Precision Tree reticle allows you to quickly hold for range and wind regardless of magnification. The exposed elevation zero stop allows you to quickly return to zero. Includes Sunshade, Tenebraex Flip Caps, Scopecoat, 3mm and 1.5mm Hex key, repositionable magnification knob and replacement screw, CR2032 battery, quick reference guide.
